shorts_extract.hook: Clip 1: a volunteer at the thirty-switch panel presses a lever (red light flashes, needle jumps) while the man in the grey coat behind him says 'please continue'.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Rigged draw, strapped learner, the wall pounding then silence, 26 of 40 to 450 V versus the students' one-in-a-hundred guess; variations: same room 40 percent, hand on plate 30 percent, Bridgeport office 47.5 percent; Burger 2009 70 percent at 150 V.
shorts_extract.twist: Bare orders failed: people continued when told 'the experiment requires that you continue' but typically refused 'you have no other choice'; across all versions most people stopped.
